data.mission: Empowering beekeepers, protecting bees, ensuring honey authenticity

data.name: Timothy Nduva
data.story: Timothy is a master beekeeper in Kibwezi, dedicated to sustainable pollination and protecting the African honey bee.

data.name: Timothy Nduva
data.story: Timothy Nduva started in 2020 with just 4 hives. Through dedication to the "50/50 Harvest Promise" (taking only half, leaving half for the bees), he has scaled to 184 hives on a 5-acre fenced apiary. He has planted over 2500 trees to support the local biome, creating a true sanctuary for bees in Kibwezi.

data.name: Kibwezi Main Apiary
data.description: 5-acre fenced sanctuary with over 2500 planted trees. Scaled from 4 hives in 2020 to 184 hives today.
